about: Bangladeshi universities (UGC-approved, public + private) and the email domains their students sign in with. Source of truth for backend/migrations universities seed: edit here, then run backend/tools/universities/generate.py.
rules: sign_in_domains = website + student_email_domains + alias_domains; every subdomain of these also matches (longest match wins).
Cross-domain student domains are accepted only when they clearly belong to the same institution; unverified ones go to held_domains.
Never a shared suffix (ac.bd, edu.bd) or free mail provider: the database refuses them (migration 00105).

universities.name: Ahsania Mission University of Science and Technology
universities.notes: Live site https://www.amust.ac.bd/ (matches UGC). Only info-type contacts seen; no student email evidence; amust.ac.bd has no MX record. Bangla name on site appears only inflected (…বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের), so name_bn null.

universities.name: Brahmaputra International University
universities.notes: http://www.briu.ac.bd shows a hosting 'website has been stopped' page; https://briu.ac.bd/ is live. Portal at portal.briu.ac.bd. UGC also lists briuniversitybd@gmail.com. No student email evidence.

universities.name: City University

universities.name: Daffodil International University

Official IT page: students get a Google (G Suite) email tied to student ID; official forum thread titled 'Our Email address (@diu.edu.bd)'; search snippets of official alumni pages show <id>@diu.edu.bd; student portal is studentportal.diu.edu.bd. diu.edu.bd and s.diu.edu.bd both have Google MX (s.diu.edu.bd possibly a newer student subdomain, covered by subdomain match). daffodilvarsity.edu.bd is used for office/staff addresses (info@, admission@, itsupport@, iceoffice@); a class routine shows faculty on both domains; no evidence students get @daffodilvarsity.edu.bd.

universities.name: Dhaka International University
universities.notes: NOT Daffodil. Site www.diu.ac (title 'DIU | Dhaka International University'); UGC contacts use diu.net.bd (MX Microsoft 365). Student portal students.diu.ac logs in by email, and students.diu.ac itself has a Microsoft 365 MX record, which hints at @students.diu.ac student mailboxes, but no published address confirms it. If you add diu.ac, subdomain matching would cover it. Never map diu.edu.bd here.

No student email evidence. name_bn appears uninflected on own site, as 'এক্সিম ব্যাংক কৃষি বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় বাংলাদেশ-এ ...' in news cards.

universities.name: Feni University

universities.notes: curl gets 406 (bot filter), WebFetch works. Footer: 38 T&T Road, Joydebpur, Gazipur. info@gub.edu.bd; webmail links go to mail.google.com/a/gub.edu.bd and gub.edu.bd:2096 (cPanel). Student portal is on third-party gub.pipilikasoft.com. No student email evidence. name_bn appears uninflected on own site in 'গণ বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় বোর্ড অব ট্রাস্টিজের ৫৮তম সভা অনুষ্ঠিত' (news headline) and matches the transliterated English name.

universities.name: Grameen University
universities.notes: UGC lists no website. https://grameenu.ac/ is live (title 'Grameen University - Dedicated to creating the world of three zeros', info@grameenu.ac, Microsoft 365 MX). Wikipedia and Chronicle job ads (career@grameenu.ac) corroborate it. Note .ac is the Ascension Island TLD, not .ac.bd. Address is South Diabari, Turag. Academic activity may not have started, and there is no student email evidence.

universities.name: Green University of Bangladesh
universities.notes: Homepage footer gives only the permanent campus: Purbachal American City, Kanchan, Rupganj, Narayanganj-1461. Search snippets of two official EEE-dept Summer 2026 thesis lists show student addresses like <studentID>@student.green.ac.bd, a DIFFERENT registrable domain (green.ac.bd). I could not fetch the PDFs myself (eee.green.edu.bd does not resolve from here) and green.ac.bd returned no DNS records here, though .bd DNS is unreliable from this network. Staff use @green.edu.bd. An archived 'Email Activation' page says students look up their address at email.green.edu.bd and log in through Google. Recommend also allowing green.edu.bd. student.green.ac.bd seen only in search results (thesis PDFs); green.ac.bd ownership unverified, so held back.

universities.name: Hamdard University Bangladesh
universities.notes: Live over http at www.hamdarduniversity.edu.bd. Address: Hamdard City of Science, Education & Culture, Gazaria, Munshiganj-1510. The domain uses Google Workspace MX and an ICT office exists (ict@hamdarduniversity.edu.bd), but no student-address evidence was found.

universities.name: Independent University, Bangladesh
universities.notes: UGC lists www.iub.edu.bd, which 301s to iub.ac.bd (live site). Official IUB notice (2020 PDF): student email = 7-digit ID@iub.edu.bd via Gmail (e.g. 2030100@iub.edu.bd). iub.edu.bd MX = Google; iub.ac.bd has NO MX record, so it cannot receive mail; site contact is still info@iub.edu.bd. Many IUB student GitHub projects whitelist @iub.edu.bd.
